facts.text: The hotel sits on the western edge of Nara Park.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the western edge of Nara Park, one of Japan’s most famous scenic spots, is Shisui, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Nara.

facts.text: The Yoshikien area where the hotel is located is surrounded by World Heritage Sites such as Kasuga Taisha Shrine, Kofukuji Temple and Todaiji Temple.
facts.excerpt: by World Heritage Sites such as Kasuga Taisha Shrine, Kofukuji Temple and Todaiji Temple, and has been protected by efforts to maintain the area’s lush greenery

facts.text: The hotel's name derives from the 'purple trunk and green leaves (Shikan Suiyou)', scenic vistas cherished in Nara since ancient times.
facts.excerpt: derives from the “purple trunk and green leaves (Shikan Suiyou)” – scenic vistas that have been cherished in Nara since ancient times

facts.text: Some rooms offer private natural hot spring baths.
facts.excerpt: Some rooms at our Nara private onsen hotel offer private natural hot spring baths

facts.text: Room types include Deluxe rooms with open-air onsen baths and a Presidential Suite with onsen.
facts.excerpt:
Presidential Suite ONSEN

1 Bedroom Presidential Suite, 2 Twin, Garden view

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows looking onto greenery.
facts.excerpt: Beautiful greenery can be seen from floor-to-ceiling windows in our Nara hotel room

facts.text: The accommodations are decorated with Nara's traditional artworks.
facts.excerpt: Our Nara onsen hotel accommodations are decorated with Nara's traditional artworks

facts.text: Rooms have natural light, an open space concept and lofty ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Walk into your room filled with natural light, an open space concept and lofty ceilings

facts.text: SUI Spa offers Nara massage and spa treatments using traditional Japanese and Chinese herbs nurtured by the nature of Nara.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to our indigenous Nara massage and spa treatments using traditional Japanese and Chinese herbs nurtured by the nature of Nara to restore vitality.

facts.text: Sushi & Bar Shousou is a modern counter-style sushi restaurant in the refurbished warehouse of the historic Governor's House, dating from 1922.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a modern counter-style sushi restaurant in Nara, Japan, within the refurbished warehouse of the historic Governor's House, dating from 1922.

facts.text: Restaurant Suiyou serves Japanese cuisine reflecting Nara's culinary culture, shaped by the Silk Road.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a gastronomic journey at Restaurant “Suiyou,” where Nara’s rich culinary culture, traditions and passage of time have been shaped by the Silk Road.

facts.text: The hotel holds a 2026 Michelin Key award (1 Key).
The minimum age to check in is 18.
Parking is beyond the entrance gate and must be booked; steps may prevent access for low vehicles.
facts.excerpt: Booking required. The property is beyond the entrance gate; steps may prevent access for low vehicles.

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day and complimentary for staying guests.
facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

facts.text: Staff speak Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean.
Nearby train stations are Nara Station and Kintetsu Nara Station.
The hotel describes itself as a heritage hotel where guests can indulge in the history and traditions of the city.
